summary: Frontend-only test of RECOMP (Expo web preview, sql.js/localStorage, 390x844). Tested end to end: onboarding (with validation), tabs, Hinglish food search, qty scaling, add/edit/delete/move entries, quick add, custom food, text-log review, recipes, saved meals, water, steps, sleep across midnight, check-in, workout plan -> active session (sets, rest timer, pause, reload recovery, no duplicate session) -> finish summary/history/PRs, measurements + chart + edit/delete, profile edit, units, AI settings and offline parser, report, achievements, and persistence after reload. Most flows work. Bugs found: (1) the Dark theme does nothing on web, (2) text-log review isn't required for items given in grams, (3) data entered less than 250ms before a reload is lost on web. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: Choosing Dark (settings-theme-dark) saves the setting but the UI stays light. The background stays rgb(247,244,255) on Settings and Home, even after navigating away. RCA: applyThemePref relies on Appearance.setColorScheme, which does nothing on react-native-web, and useTheme() only reads useColorScheme(). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:106-120

Items with explicit grams (e.g. '150g rice') start out confirmed (ok = !needsReview). So 'Add All to Meal' becomes enabled after confirming only the roti and dal items. Tapping 'Looks right' on that pre-confirmed item un-confirms it, which is confusing. This breaks the requirement that save stays disabled until every item is confirmed. Reference: /app/frontend/app/food/ai-log.tsx:37,44

Data loss on quick reload: tapping water-add-250 and reloading about 50ms later shows 0 ml. persist() is debounced by 250ms and nothing flushes the pending save on pagehide, beforeunload or visibilitychange. Reference: /app/frontend/src/db/client.web.ts:10-22
There is no upper limit or sanity warning on quantity. 250 servings of paneer (5000 g, 13250 kcal) is accepted.
session-prs is empty after the first completed session, but the Records screen shows a best of 70 kg and an estimated 1RM. Check whether first-session PRs should be highlighted.

issues: Greeting truncates to 'Good evening, …' at 390px, so the user's name (TEST_Ravi) is never visible. Consider moving the name to a second line or shrinking the font.
Every food (roti, paneer, custom protein bar) shows the same sausage-and-rice bowl illustration, which doesn't match the food. Use a neutral food icon or a per-category image.
Toast (e.g. 'Logged to Snacks · Today') covers the header back button and title for its whole duration.
After a successful profile-save the screen stays on /profile/edit instead of going back. Confirm this is intended.

react_native_issues.issue: Theme override depends on Appearance.setColorScheme, which react-native-web doesn't implement. Keep the theme preference in React state/context and work out the scheme from preference plus system. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:106-120

The dev LogBox toast for the react-native-svg warning 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' sits over the bottom tab bar and intercepts real taps on the web preview. Tests had to use dispatch_event clicks. Known and ignored per instructions; consider LogBox.ignoreLogs for this warning.

action_items: Fix the theme: keep the pref (light/dark/system) in a context or store read by useTheme(), and use useColorScheme() only when pref is 'system' (src/theme.ts). Re-verify dark mode on Home, Settings and the tab bar.
ai-log.tsx: start every resolved item with ok:false so the user must tap 'Looks right' on all items before ai-log-save is enabled.
client.web.ts: flush pending persist() immediately on 'pagehide', 'beforeunload' and visibilitychange 'hidden', or persist right away after each write.
Add a sanity cap or warning for very large quantities in the food detail and quick add screens.
Show the user's name in the Home greeting without truncating it at 390px.
backup.ts restore (line ~68): whitelist column names against PRAGMA table_info before putting backup JSON keys into INSERT SQL.
Optional: LogBox.ignoreLogs(['Invalid DOM property']) so the dev toast doesn't cover the tab bar.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/backup.ts:62-68: column names from an untrusted backup file are interpolated into SQL (INSERT INTO t(cols)). This is local-only but allows malformed or crafted SQL. Validate them against the schema.
src/db/client.web.ts: the 250ms debounced persist with no unload flush causes data loss (reproduced).
src/theme.ts: Appearance.setColorScheme is called at module load to force light, and the user preference can't override it on web.
app/food/ai-log.tsx:37: auto-confirming items with explicit grams goes against the 'mandatory review' requirement.
Expo Router on web keeps previous screens mounted, so the same testIDs exist several times in the DOM. Tests must use the ':visible' filter.
No deprecated Expo packages found. Gemini key stored via the secure storage helper (expo-secure-store).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (3 functional bugs out of ~30 verified flows)

seed_data_creation: Each browser run started with fresh localStorage, so data was created only inside the test browser (TEST_Ravi profile, TEST_ foods, recipe, plan). No server data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts with empty localStorage, so every script must finish onboarding first: next, then name/age/height/weight, then onboarding-next-button 5x. Use page.locator('[data-testid=x]:visible').first.dispatch_event('click') for taps: the LogBox transform-origin toast blocks force-clicks on the tab bar, and old screens stay in the DOM. Tabs: log-food-tabs-quick, recipes-tabs-recipes, activity-tabs-sleep/checkin. Units: settings-unit-weight-lb. Browser date is Nov 2026.
rca_of_issue: Theme: react-native-web Appearance has no setColorScheme, so useColorScheme() always returns the browser's 'light'. Text log: resolveItems sets needsReview only for assumed or unknown portions, and ai-log maps ok = !needsReview. Persistence: setTimeout(250) debounce in client.web.ts persist() is lost when the page unloads before the timer fires (reproduced: add 250 ml, reload after 50 ms, total shows 0 ml).
